title: CreateDataQualityDimensionRequest
description: Schema corresponding to a Data Quality Dimension

name.description: Unique technical name used in the API. It cannot be changed after creation because test definitions and test cases reference it.

displayName.description: Name shown in the test library, dashboards and the dimension picker.

description.description: Description of what this dimension measures and when to use it.

style.description: UI style, holding the colour the dimension is rendered with.

owners.description: Owners of this data quality dimension.

domains.description: Fully qualified names of the domains the Data Quality Dimension belongs to.
